name: my dear Linda
source:
After the death of her daughter, Claire gets the opportunity to see her one last time. The path leads the woman to an abandoned dollhouse - a strange place on the verge of life and death, where toys come to life, childhood memories take on eerie forms, and every turn hides another piece of the truth.

Explore the house, talk with its residents and gradually discover the truth about the events that led Linda to this place. To save her daughter, Claire will have to face not only the horrors of her dream, but also her own mistakes that she has refused to admit for so long.

[From [url=https://one-to-seven.itch.io/my-dear-linda]itch.io[/url]]
